questions.question_text: On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -5 and 5.

Increase $55 by 250%.
Beatrice invests $500 at a rate of 1.5% per year simple interest. Find the amount Beatrice has at the end of 12 years.
Dan invests $500 at a rate of 1.5% per year compound interest. Find the difference between Dan’s amount and Beatrice’s amount at the end of 12 years.
Eva invests an amount of money at a rate of 2.1% per year compound interest. Find the number of complete years it takes for Eva’s investment to double in value.
